1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for lead suboxide (lead oxide) for lead-acid storage battery.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revisions, and parties to agreements based on this Indian Standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
